studies.title: Painted maps of the Valley of Mexico
studies.caption: Painters draw land and history together on bark paper and cloth: footprints for journeys, glyphs for towns, rivers and lakes around them.
studies.prompt: Overhead scene in the Valley of Mexico about1450CE: an Indigenous map painter uses a fine brush on bark paper, showing a blue lake, winding paths marked by footprints, stylized hill and town glyphs. Mineral pigments in small dishes, no European compass rose or Latin writing.
